g.data-label: Measured: a closed row on a constructor payload (or record field) bounds NOTHING handed to it. The only compiler gate is the row of the enclosing registration function — which a rowless or wide register_with_config defeats via a separately-declared named function. §3.3's 'per-slot compiler enforcement is untouched' is FALSE as an enforcement claim.

text.tspan: Measured: a closed row on a constructor payload (or record field) bounds NOTHING handed to it.
The only compiler gate is the row of the enclosing registration function — which a rowless or wide
register_with_config defeats via a separately-declared named function.
§3.3's 'per-slot compiler enforcement is untouched' is FALSE as an enforcement claim.
